text:
Welcome back handlers,
Focused stint at the desk, and animal welfare came up

Hello team,

Thanks for the steady care you brought to the Companion Animal Travel Desk during the last shift. The notes from bookings, check-ins, and handoffs showed the usual mix of nerves and relief from travelers, and I appreciated how calmly everyone answered each concern. That kind of tone matters, because people remember whether their animals were treated with patience as much as they remember the flight itself.

Please keep the reminders simple and gentle when you speak with travelers. For reptiles, make sure the paperwork is current before anything moves ahead. <<FACT F084>> For birds, keep an eye on crate fit and spacing so the setup stays safe and comfortable. <<FACT F071>> For rabbits, double-check the total weight with the crate included before confirming acceptance. <<FACT F064>> If something looks off, pause and route it back through the desk instead of trying to smooth it over on the spot.

I also want to note the care taken with crate labeling, water checks, and pickup coordination. Small details like that help Aurelia Skyways keep the journey humane from booking through arrival, and they reduce confusion for both handlers and travelers. Keep using clear, kind language, and please continue to record any unusual behavior, stress signs, or special handling notes in the file right away. That record trail helps the next person at the desk pick up smoothly and keeps everyone on the same page.

Thanks again for the thoughtful work and the steady attention to animal welfare.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
